doc.name: Hostlet
doc.instructions: Hostlet builds a real website for someone's business, club, building or project from a sentence, with its own AI that answers visitors, at name.hostlet.ai. Use make_website (it shows a live card and builds in about two minutes), then change_site for any change the user asks for, add_document to teach the site's AI, and check_site to show it again. make_ai makes just a simple chat AI. Never show the owner_key in your reply; the card has the private edit link.

tools.name: make_website
tools.title: Make a website
tools.description: Build a real website for the user's business, club, building, class or project from a sentence or two, with its own AI that answers visitors' questions. Hostlet designs the whole thing (words, layout, photos, logo) in about two minutes. It returns right away with a live card and the address; the site appears there when it is done. Ask only what you need: what they run and anything that makes it theirs (place, what they offer). Do not ask about colors or layout.

about.description: What they run, in their words plus any useful details they gave: e.g. "A small bakery on Maple Street in Portland. Sourdough, croissants, open Tue to Sun 7 to 3."

name.description: The name of the business or group, if they said it.

tools.name: make_ai
tools.title: Make a simple AI
tools.description: Make a simple chat AI (like a small ChatGPT for one job, with a chat history) on its own page, in a few seconds. Use when the user wants just an assistant, not a website.

about.description: What the AI should help with, e.g. "helps my students practice Spanish verbs".

tools.name: change_site
tools.title: Change a Hostlet site
tools.description: Change a site made with make_website, in plain words: "make the headline shorter", "add our hours: Tue to Sun 7 to 3", "add a section about catering", "use warmer colors". Pass exactly what the user asked for.

change.description: What to change, in the user's words.

tools.name: check_site
tools.title: Show a Hostlet site
tools.description: Show a Hostlet site or AI the user made, as a card, and whether it is finished building.

tools.name: add_document
tools.title: Teach a Hostlet site
tools.description: Give a site's AI a document to answer visitors from (a menu, price list, rules, FAQ): pass its title and full text.

tools.name: ask_site
tools.title: Ask a Hostlet site
tools.description: Ask any public Hostlet site's AI a question (e.g. "night-owls" for night-owls.hostlet.ai). Pass passcode if the site has one, or owner_key for your own.
